## Activity

Capture activity at Hill Counties Health Centre during June 2019 totalled 76. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the operational basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Overall, the site maintained its scheduled capture activity, with the available session information showing no reported disruption other than routine leave.

## Image quality

Of the 76 captures, 3 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.9. The ungradable images should be considered when reviewing the month’s overall results and any opportunities to support consistent image capture. The report records the outcome without identifying a further cause for the ungradable results.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during June 2019. The median grading lag was 2. Taken together, the grading figures provide a summary of the month’s referral workload and reporting timeliness. The median lag indicates the central grading turnaround recorded for the site, while the referable total identifies the results requiring referral. These figures should be read alongside the activity and image-quality measures above.
